register.status: storm response register v1 - suggested values (31 Oct 2026); land cover from the hydrogeologist added 2 Nov 2026; capture, pond and use aligned with the net zero plan and the 141 flats on 3 Nov 2026 (v1.13.1); nothing here is tested on site
register.approval: suggested by Claude; to be reviewed and approved by the hydrogeologist

entries.parameter: share of the lease that is paved or hard-standing (the 40 ft tar road), roofs excluded
entries.basis: derived from the hydrogeologist's land cover (2 Nov 2026): one 40 ft (12.19 m) tar road; length 200 / 300 / 400 m is a PLACEHOLDER; lease 43,476 m2. Since v1.13.1 the storm views compute it from road width x road length (SR13 x SR14) unless you type a value here
entries.status: placeholder - replace when site plan is ready
entries.field_measurement_to_test: site plan (road length, any other hard-standing)
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: runoff coefficient of the tar road (applied to the rain after the first 1 mm of wetting)
entries.basis: standard tables give 0.70-0.95 for asphalt; the NRCS curve number for paved streets is 98, which sheds 0.94-0.95 of a 100-150 mm storm; 0.90 allows for cracks, gravel shoulders and ponding
entries.field_measurement_to_test: site plan, surface survey, a gauged storm on the road
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: SCS curve number of open ground at average wetness (AMC II)
entries.basis: assumption for red weathered soil with scrub / sparse grass / permaculture beds (hydrologic soil group C); not measured
entries.field_measurement_to_test: infiltration test (double ring), soil survey, rainfall-runoff record from a gauged storm
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions
entries.expected_influence: runoff from open ground (the largest area)

entries.parameter: share of non-roof runoff that can be led to the pond by gravity
entries.basis: net zero plan (D-038, 2 Nov 2026): all land runoff is led to the reservoir; lower values only test a partial drain layout. Confirm with the site plan and contour layout (only land that drains toward the reservoir can be captured)
entries.status: placeholder - replace when site plan is ready
entries.field_measurement_to_test: site plan with contours, drain layout
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: time of concentration of the catchment (rain on the farthest point to the pond)
entries.basis: assumption for a 4 ha gently sloping lease; replace with the drain layout
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: position of the rain peak inside the storm (share of the duration)
entries.basis: assumption: triangular storm, peak about 40 % in; real cloudbursts are often front loaded; no hourly record exists
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: storage pond volume (usable, up to the spillway)
entries.basis: net zero plan default reservoir (D-044, hydrogeologist 3 Nov 2026): 5,000 m3 holds the 135 mm GEV 100-year day on wet ground even when it falls as a 1 h burst (about 4,900 m3; 4,776 m3 for a 24 h storm); PLACEHOLDER until the reservoir design is ready; the planner also shows the volume that is needed
entries.status: placeholder - replace when site plan is ready
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: mean depth of the pond when full (sets surface area for evaporation)
entries.basis: PLACEHOLDER until the pond design is ready; pond assumed lined (no seepage)
entries.status: placeholder - replace when site plan is ready
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.basis: assumption for the Kolar plateau (pan evaporation about 4-6 mm/d in dry months, less in the monsoon)
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions

entries.parameter: radius of the rock around each recharge well that is counted as its storage zone
entries.basis: assumption: how far injected water is expected to spread before it is no longer 'near the well'; M7d checks 200 m; not measured
entries.field_measurement_to_test: injection test with observation wells, water-level monitoring around the well
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions
entries.expected_influence: the pore space that can hold the water near the well

entries.parameter: water use that can be taken from the pond (drinking-quality use after treatment)
entries.basis: 141 flats x 4 / 5 / 6 persons x 90 L per person per day (135 L/d less 45 L/d flushing); flushing, irrigation and the fountain come from treated wastewater, as in the risk calendar and drought view (2 Nov 2026); replaces the earlier 43 m3/d for 96 residents
entries.spatial_applicability: whole lease; pond and wells at the planned positions
entries.expected_influence: water that is used instead of recharged

entries.basis: assumption; gravity feed from the reservoir; the injection-well rule (Thiem) assumes the open section is below the water table

all.label: All wells together
all.text: Every well takes water at its limit from the first litre. The buffer empties fastest.

shallow_first.label: Shallow first, deeper wells open as the buffer fills
shallow_first.text: Shallow wells always work; moderate wells open when the buffer is 40 % full; the deep well opens at 70 %. Keeps the deep well for the largest storms. Slower: wells close again as the buffer empties.

deep_first.label: Deep first, shallower wells open as the buffer fills
deep_first.text: The deep well works first (water arrives at the water table soon, little dry-rock delay); moderate at 40 %, shallow at 70 %.

moderate_first.label: Moderate first, others as the buffer fills
moderate_first.text: Moderate wells (usually the highest intake) work first; shallow at 40 %, deep at 70 %.

custom.label: Custom opening levels
custom.text: You set the buffer level (share of full) at which each well class opens.
